FIELDS.NAME: Comfort Haven Furniture
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Operations Manager, Comfort Haven Furniture, 123 Comfort Way, Springfield, IL 62704-5678, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@comforthaven.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Comfort Haven Furniture is a retail establishment specializing in the sale and installation of high-quality furniture for residential and commercial spaces. Our operations include a showroom of less than 10,000 square feet, showcasing a diverse selection of products including living room, bedroom, and dining room furniture, as well as home decor accessories. We prioritize customer satisfaction by providing tailored delivery and installation services, carried out by our dedicated team of employees who are fully trained and insured. Our commitment to safety includes having comprehensive policies and procedures in place for lifting and assembling furniture, ensuring a safe and efficient service for our customers. We do not engage in any on-site woodworking, manufacturing, or reupholstering activities, which helps us minimize fire and liability risks. We maintain a monitored security system for our inventory stored in our well-maintained, sprinklered facility, ensuring protection against potential losses.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Comfort Haven Decor LLC, specializing in home staging services and decor consultations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/15/2022; Cause: Water damage from a plumbing failure in the showroom; Amount: $1,200; Status: Resolved with insurance claim.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B safe, UL-rated, fire-resistant, with a theft protection label.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security system with alarm response and external fencing around the premises.
